name: Androsphinx Heritage
body:
One of your parents was a regal androsphinx and you now know just how important you are.

Prerequisite(s): Half-Sphinx, cannot possess any other feat with “half-sphinx” as a prerequisite and “heritage” in it’s name

Benefit(s): Once per day you can take a standard action to let out a supernaturally powerful androsphinx roar. It is a mind-affecting, sonic, fear effect that fill a 30-foot-radius burst, centered on the half-sphinx; the save is DC 10 + 1/2 character level + your Charismabased. If a creature fails it is frightened for 1d6 rounds. All sphinxes (including other half-sphinxes) are immune to the effects of this roar. You gain 1 additional use of this ability for every 5 character levels you possess.
